title: Commit Rewarder - Open-Source DAO Tool
tagline: Our hackathon project uses Github Action and ChatGPT as the backbone to support our token reward system managed by CommitRewarder. We incentivize high-quality code contributions to open-source projects, promoting sustainability in the crypto world.
description:
Our hackathon project aims to address the challenges of maintaining open-source projects in the crypto world. While open-source projects are critical for the growth and sustainability of the industry, adopting code contributions from multiple developers can be time-consuming and challenging for project owners and maintainers. Additionally, it can be challenging for developers to follow coding standards and maintain code quality.

To address these challenges, our team developed a novel solution that leverages token rewards managed by CommitRewarder to incentivize and reward high-quality code contributions. Our solution integrates with Github Action and ChatGPT as the backbone to support our token reward system. Developers who submit code that meets our project's coding standards can earn tokens and NFT badges, promoting sustainability in the crypto world.

Our solution offers several benefits for open-source projects. First, it incentivizes developers to submit high-quality code that meets coding standards, helping to maintain code quality and ensure the long-term sustainability of the project. Second, it streamlines the code adoption process by allowing project owners and maintainers to focus on reviewing high-quality code submissions, saving time and resources. Finally, it promotes community engagement and collaboration by encouraging developers to contribute to open-source projects and earn rewards for their efforts.

To implement our solution, we developed a Github Action that integrates with CommitRewarder to manage token rewards and NFT badges. Our solution uses ChatGPT as the backbone to provide code suggestions and feedback to developers, helping them to improve their code quality and meet our project's coding standards. The ChatGPT model provides a reliable and accurate method for evaluating code submissions, ensuring that we can maintain code quality while scaling our solution to multiple projects.

Overall, our project aims to improve the sustainability and code quality of open-source projects in the crypto world. By incentivizing and rewarding high-quality code contributions, we can create a more engaged and collaborative community of developers working together to build innovative and sustainable open-source projects.
